Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: AnimalTown top-down game terrain transition, ONE square unmarked 3x3 nine-slice atlas. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Keep its exact composition, outer terrain, organic boundary location, rounded island corners, painterly texture style and small exterior details. Replace ONLY the orange terracotta island surface, all the way up to its organic fringe, with the requested center material. Preserve the clearly visible physical fringe around all four sides and corners. Keep the central third square entirely center material; cuts at 1/3 and 2/3 cross continuous artwork with no gaps. Full-bleed opaque square PNG, flat orthographic view, diffuse lighting. NO perspective, labels, text, grid lines, gutters, frame, or paving remnants where the new center should be.
CENTER MATERIAL: rich turquoise-blue WATER, softly mottled painterly aquatic texture, delicate small curved white ripple highlights and subtle light aqua wave patterns. Surface stays flat and uniformly water in the center, no stones, islands, objects, or frozen surface. The organic terrain fringe becomes a clear shoreline, with dark blue shallow-water contact shadow immediately under the grass, leaves, snowbank or sand lip. Water itself is the same turquoise palette in every seasonal variant.
BORDER VARIANT: SPRING. Preserve vivid green triangular-pattern grass and pointed green grass/clover fringe with contact shadow.
